findings.summary: S11-T02 does not implement the declared uniform external failure contract.
findings.details: The task packet says external headless failures are uniformly Unauthorized, Forbidden, ValidationFailed, or RateLimited. The implementation still exposes NotFound for public headless route/operation failures, and RateLimited is only an exported helper/type member with no reachable request path or executable proof. This leaves declared failure paths both over-broad and under-implemented for downstream API/CLI/MCP consumers that depend on the S11-T02 contract.
